patches.detail: artifact-result evidence type verified in issue_execution with artifact_id and digest checking against physical artifacts table.
Separated _issue_execution_record from public issue_execution; enforces world-event in events table and pipeline-result in pipeline_runs.
Test fixtures migrated to use _issue_fixture_execution rather than attempting to forge synthetic production receipts.
ResolutionGovernor.__init__ installs v11 migrations (migrations 019-022) before establishing db connection.
Removed optional table-existence check; pipeline run unconditionally installs v11 and mediates via begin_domain_operation and complete_domain_operation.
install_situations and install_all updated to install migration_023.sql (component situation_architecture).
